link.description: What this is about: one or more concepts, each with how close the match is and which way a higher value points.

Concept.description: A PRISM concept ID (prism:<slug>) or the absolute URL of a concept in an external vocabulary.

Match.description: How closely the concept matches (SKOS: exactMatch, broadMatch, narrowMatch, relatedMatch). Default: exact.

Higher.description: Whether a higher value means more or less of the concept.

Source.description: Who or what made the link (a person, a paper, a tool).

Checked.description: Date the link was last checked (YYYY-MM-DD).

LevelIsAbout.description: Concept links for single values, keyed by the level code of Levels.

ValueMappings.description: Named, sourced rules that turn a value into a state a reasoner can use. Several may exist and may disagree; none is the truth.

State.description: For example present, absent, high, low.

TermURL.description: A string is a URL of a definition (the BIDS reading). An object maps a vocabulary name to the URL of this same thing in that vocabulary.
